text:
nina: Heads-up — drafting the release notes for the streaming-chat change: the `chunked` parameter is being removed and replaced with `stream_mode` (values: `none`, `delta`, `full`). Putting the draft + SDK migration snippets here for quick review before I open the PR.

maria-docs: nice. please include a short compatibility table and a 'how to test' checklist. need to surface known issue about interrupted streams returning partial deltas.

chris-sdk: migration snippets please. we should show both old and new usage for JS and Python so customers can grep-and-replace. also call out which SDK versions support the new param (js v1.2.0+, py v0.9.1+).

nina: adding examples. JS before/after:
```js
// old: chunked param
await client.chat.stream({ model: 'kestrel-chat', messages, chunked: true });

// new: stream_mode param (recommended: 'delta' for small updates)
await client.chat.stream({ model: 'kestrel-chat', messages, stream_mode: 'delta' });
```

nina: Python snippet:
```py
# old
client.chat.stream(model='kestrel-chat', messages=messages, chunked=True)

# new
client.chat.stream(model='kestrel-chat', messages=messages, stream_mode='delta')
```

sam-engineering: runtime note: the new `full` mode will preserve previous behavior (large cumulative frames) but has ~8% higher memory spike for long-lived sessions. add a perf blurb so customers understand tradeoffs.

maria-docs: add a 'what to look for in logs' section: look for EOF vs CANCELled stream markers; link to streaming-runbook. Also add a short test harness snippet to repro partial-delta bug.

nina: added repro test snippet (JS eval harness) and a migration checklist: 1) upgrade SDK 2) replace `chunked` with `stream_mode` 3) run integration tests 4) verify stream boundary metrics 5) roll canary to <5% traffic.

rick-pm: product note — we'll announce this as a breaking-but-planned change in the changelog with a 2-week deprecation notice. Recommend a one-paragraph blurb for the What's New entry. Also ask Support to contact customers who have >1000 active streaming sessions.

maria-docs: I'll draft the What's New blurb and include the Support template. For docs link housekeeping: the streaming runbook link changed anchor after the last site restructure; can someone fix the anchor to `#stream-boundaries` in the troubleshooting page? Ticket #8020 filed.

chris-sdk: small SDK nit: JS example should use `streamMode` in camelCase for v1.x transports that accept client options; but the REST payload uses `stream_mode`. We should show both to avoid confusion.

nina: good call — I'll include both variants and a short note about naming differences between SDK and REST.

sam-engineering: known issue: interrupted streams on mobile may resume with duplicated tokens in `full` mode. Add a callout in Known Issues and suggest `delta` for mobile clients until fixed. Also pin runtime >= v1.5.0 for `stream_mode` header compatibility.

deploy-bot: nina pushed branch nina/stream-mode-relnotes -> staging/docs (CI: passing) :white_check_mark:

nina: thanks. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7209 — includes snippets, compatibility table, perf notes, known-issues, and a redirect fix for the runbook anchor.

maria-docs: I'll proof the What's New blurb tomorrow AM. small editorial suggestion: avoid the word 'deprecated' in titles — use 'updating streaming options' instead.

rick-pm: after publish, marketing will prepare a short in-product banner for users on older clients. Support will get the template for proactive outreach.

chris-sdk: one last ask — can we add a minimal migration script (sed/grep) in the docs repo examples to help teams automate the rename? saves customers time.

nina: adding a tiny sed snippet in PR. merging when green and then scheduling relnotes publish on Thursday 09:00 PT. I'll post back with the publish timestamp and the product/support blurbs.

maria-docs: sounds good. thanks everyone — will open a follow-up thread if any link fixes fail the site build.

nina: closing this thread — will update with live timestamp after publish.
